name: cousins_correction
hook: Our model had a bug. Here's the fix.
note: Week 10: after his trade (9 games for LV, then MIN in Week 10) Cousins was credited with Minnesota's 7-2 record and paced on its 9 games. Counted by stint he is 5-5 over 10 games. Record fix alone: No. 6 -> No. 12; games fix alone: No. 9; both: No. 19.

beats.text: Our model had a bug this week. Here's the fix.
Kirk Cousins jumped to No. 6. But he played nine games for the Raiders and just one for the Vikings.
We were giving him Minnesota's 7-2 record. His real record is 5-5. Fixing just the record dropped him six spots.
That's the evidence. Team performance moves this model. He's No. 19 now.
The corrected board is up. Full board at stingercollectibles.com

script.instagram_caption: Our model had a bug: after his trade, Kirk Cousins was credited with Minnesota's 7-2 record for nine Raiders games. With his real 5-5 he goes from No. 6 to No. 19, and the record alone was worth six spots. Full board at stingercollectibles.com
